purpose: Specify an internal grid that places the lead persistence endpoint beside abundance and lake-refuge support.
proposed_structure: Rows for primary pressure-removal interventions; columns for persistence 2002 direction, abundance median, lake-refuge median, audited source flags, A03 caution, and review decision placeholder.
key_caveats: Must keep the three-endpoint bundle together; must flag A03 before any single-pressure wording.
stop_condition: Stop if the artefact starts selecting one endpoint as sufficient by itself or suppresses the A03 caution.

purpose: Specify a future visual concept comparing pressure-removal rows across the accepted endpoint bundle.
proposed_structure: Concept uses primary partition first, then sensitivity rows; each pressure-removal row would carry endpoint medians, direction proportions, and audit-caution tags.
key_caveats: This goal does not create the visual; transient-perfect-storm no-trout must carry A10 as sensitivity caution only.
stop_condition: Stop if the concept becomes a rendered visual or gives sensitivity partitions equal lead status.

purpose: Specify an internal appendix-style grid for selected source/intervention audit evidence.
proposed_structure: Rows for A01, A02, A03, A04, A05, and A10; columns for endpoint, unit count, replicate coverage, negative/zero/positive counts, review use, and caution text.
key_caveats: Source-level material is audit context; it should not be converted into narrative proof.
stop_condition: Stop if raw rows are requested or if audit rows are expanded beyond the authorized compact outputs.

purpose: Specify a compact internal grid that keeps sensitivity, diagnostic sidecar, and negative-reference context visible without headline weighting.
proposed_structure: Sections for climbing-only sensitivity, transient-perfect-storm sensitivity, diagnostic sidecar, and negative references; columns for review role, endpoint-bundle behavior, caution, and allowed use.
key_caveats: A10 remains sensitivity caution; diagnostic and negative-reference rows remain QC/context only.
stop_condition: Stop if diagnostic or negative-reference rows are used as headline evidence.

purpose: Specify a checklist Barry/Galaxias can use before later review text or artefact construction.
proposed_structure: Checklist groups allowed internal language, blocked stronger language, release condition, and reviewer signoff question.
key_caveats: Checklist governs internal review only; it does not authorize paper-facing phrasing.
stop_condition: Stop if checklist text becomes public wording or stronger causal language.
